description: Parent agent host. Reaches ASG only through a loopback tunnel; never touches the open web.

steps.step: Open the SSH tunnel to the hub (loopback only)
Register asg-mcp and the asg-parent skill with the parent agent harness (presets/parent/mcp/README.md)
Back up the asg-mcp config on the parent host before switching to generic names (lab.web_research.task / lab.artifacts.submit / lab_worker)
After the switch, validate JSON (python -m json.tool), confirm MCP initialize and tools/list, and confirm asg_inspect answers
To roll back, restore the backed-up asg-mcp config, restart the MCP server, and confirm hub healthz through the tunnel
